::: {.page-banner}
# Application Details
:::

::: grid


::: {.g-col-6 .text_block}
The School addresses key theoretical and empirical questions in political communication, with faculty lectures focusing on democratic citizenship, democratic backsliding and resilience, AI, digital media and misinformation, civic engagement, and polarization. Students who are working on political communication questions in these areas are invited to apply. For themes in political communication covered by our division, see the [ICA Political Communication Division homepage](https://politicalcommunication.org/).

Building on the experience of the last 17 years, the 2026 Summer School offers a unique opportunity for PhD candidates and early-career academics in communication, sociology, psychology and political science:

- to attend an immersive, five-day program that comprises lectures, master classes, paper presentations, and mentoring sessions, and
- to build long-lasting personal and scholarly relations in a celebrated friendly and productive environment.

Participation will be on a competitive basis. Candidates interested in applying to the ICA Summer School should submit a three-page research proposal or an extended abstract of a research paper on issues broadly related to political communication. Submissions should include the name, email address, institutional affiliation, a brief bio (max. 200 words) mentioning main research interests and ongoing projects. A recommendation letter should be sent by a referee of your choice via email to cdp@leeds.ac.uk by March 25 at the latest. An international selection committee will review the applications.

### Key Dates and Fees

- Application Deadline: March 23 (23:59 UK time)
- Recommendation Letter Submissions by Referees: March 25 (23:59 UK time)
- Notifications of Acceptance: April 15 
- Enrollment fee: £550 (covers accommodation, daytime meals/catering, teaching programme, and Sunday night arrival).

### Application Form

- Access the Application form [here](https://polcomm.github.io/summer-school/participation/application.html).
